RAULE CILG Sanggumang Kabataan Treasurer Barangay Dalig, Municipality of Teresa Province of Rizal Dear Mr. Raule: We refer to your letter seeking clarification in relation to your unofficial travel abroad for three (3) months. Specifically, you have interposed the following queries: I. May the Sangguniang Kabataan designate any SK Official or member of the Katipunan ng Kabataan to assume the role of the SK Treasurer on leave? 2. If so, should the temporary SK Treasurer undergo the Sangguniang Kabataan Mandatory Training and the mandatory bookkeeping training as provided by pertinent laws? Anent the first query, we make a qualification. Foremost, a careful reading of Republic Act No. 10742, otherwise known as the Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2015, as amended by Republic Act No. 11768 and its IRR reveal the lack of provision delineating the procedure in filling up temporary vacancy"es in the office of SK Treasurer. Section 19 (d) thereof pertains only to temporary vacancies in the office of the SK Chairperson. However, the Department is of the considered view that, notwithstanding the absence of an express provision both in the substantive law and its IRR, to prevent a hiatus in the discharge of SK official functions, a temporary vacancy in the office of the SK Treasurer can be resolved by invoking Section 8(j)(2) of RA No. 10742, as amended by RA No. 11768,which provides: "SECTION 8. Powers and Functions of the Sangguniang Kabataan. The Sangguniang Kabataan shall: xxx (j) Within sixty (60) days from their assumption to office, the Sangguniang Kabataan shall: Page 2 of 2

xxx (2) Appoint its secretary and treasurer; and" From the foregoing, the Department holds the view that the power to appoint SK Treasurer may also be construed as an authority to appoint an acting treasurer subject to the required qualifications. We find that the exigency of service justifies its exercise. It bears stressing that the disbursement of SK Funds is necessary to implement the programs embodied in the Comprehensive Barangay Youth Development Plan. This duty rests upon the Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson and the Sangguniang Treasurer under Section 13(d) and Section 15(c) of RA 10742. Nonetheless, we ought to emphasize that the SK may only designate as SK Treasurer any SK Official but not a member of the Katipunan ng Kabataan (KK). On this, it is necessary to clarify the meaning of the word "designation". In the case of Generoso R Sevilla v. Court of Appealsl, the Supreme Court explained that "designation imports the imposition of additional duties, upon a person already in the public service by virtue of an earlier appointment or election. It is only an additional imposition of a new obligation because the holder of the office is temporarily incapacitated to perform the functions of his office." Following the foregoing discussion, we thus hold that a KK Member may not be designated as SK Treasurer precisely because he holds no public office, either by appointment or election. Turning to Section 4 of RA 107422, a KK is an aggrupation of all citizens whose ages range from at least fifteen (15) but not more than thirty (30) years old and residing in the barangay for at least six (6) months3. We further opine that a KK Member can neither be appointed to the position as it is you who is the duly appointed SK Treasurer. As to the second query, we hold that it is not necessary for the designated Acting Treasurer to undergo the SK Mandatory Training. Under the provisions of RA 10742, as amended by RA 11768, the SK Mandatory Training (SKMT) is required for SK officials before assumption to office. It is worth mentioning that the person to be designated is an SK Official who has already undergone the said training. However, we ought to remind you that the law requires public officials with money and property accountability to comply with the bonding requirements under Section 4.1.2 of Treasury Circular No. 02-2019, which provides: "4.1.2. Every officer, agent, and employee of an LGU whose duties permit or require possession, custody or control of local government funds and properties, including but not limited to city/municipal regional/provincial mayors, governors, provincial/city/municipal/barangay/ sangguniang kabataan treasurers, G.R. No. 88498, June 9, 1992 2 SEC. 4. Katipunan ng Kabataan. — There shall be in every barangay a Katipunan ng Kabataan to be composed of all citizens of the Philippines residing in the barangay for at least six (6) months, who are at least fifteen (15) but not more than thirty (30) years of age, and who are duly registered in the list of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) and/or the records of the Sangguniang Kabataan secretary Page 2 of 2

punong barangays, and sanggunianq kabataan chairperson, including those employed as job order, contractual and casual employees, shall be accountable and responsible for said public funds and properties for the safekeeping theteof and shall be or his/her fidelity insured/bonded. " The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representation you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. It is rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have provided clarification on the matter.
